subject: Connector chaos test plan + storage fallback exercise
body:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: kate@pinecone.io
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Connector chaos test plan + storage fallback exercise

Hi Kate —

Thanks again for agreeing to run a joint connector resilience exercise. The goal: simulate realistic failure modes across the vector-store + S3 fallback path and validate our SLA fallbacks, cache warmup, and index rehydration behavior.

High-level ask: can Pinecone run a 2-hour tabletop + 3-hour live run with us the week of Apr 19? We'd like to:
- Walk the failure matrix (node OOM, index shard lag, kv-cache invalidation, S3 burst throttle)
- Execute the live run with the same prompt set we use for production (small sample attached)
- Measure latency percentiles, token cost delta, and recovery time to steady-state

Attached: connector-chaos-testplan-v1.pdf (plan + test scripts) and a short sample prompt bundle.

If that schedule looks tight, propose alternatives and we'll coordinate with Weaviate/Atlas S3 counterparts. CC'ing Olga and Vanessa for test harness details and run coordination.

Thanks,
Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[attachment: connector-chaos-testplan-v1.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

-----
From: Kate Lin <kate@pinecone.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Connector chaos test plan + storage fallback exercise

Connor —

This looks good at a glance. We can do a tabletop on Tue Apr 20 (11:00–12:30 PT) and a live run Thu Apr 22 (13:00–16:00 PT). I need to confirm a few infra items with our infra team: whether we can intentionally inject network partitions and simulate token throttling.

Two quick asks from our side:
1) Can you push the test harness repo and a small reproducible Docker image for the load runner?
2) Share the exact sample prompt set and a checklist of what metrics you expect to collect (latency p50/p95/p99, error counts, token spend).

I'll loop in our infra contact if we need deeper permissions. Thanks for putting the plan together.

–Kate
Kate Lin, Partner Engineering | Pinecone

-----
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Connector chaos test plan + storage fallback exercise

Connor / Vanessa —

Digging through the plan: main follow-ups from an ops perspective:
- Test harness: I'll publish a small Docker image (redwood/connector-loadrunner:20270413) to our staging registry containing the load generator and a KV cache emulator. Connor, I'll need your sample prompts and the prompt-to-index mapping so we can seed the cache deterministically.
- Metrics: we'll collect p50/p95/p99, error classification (timeout vs 429 vs 5xx), KV cache hit ratio, and time-to-first-successful-response post-failover. I'll add a Prometheus job and Grafana dashboard link to the Drive folder.
- Safety guardrails: we should enforce a circuit-breaker that stops the run if error rate exceeds 30% for >5 minutes or if token spend exceeds the agreed soft cap.

I'll attach a short runbook and a configurable checklist in the Drive. Assigning Ben Carter to own the telemetry dashboards during the run.

Thanks,
Olga
Principal Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: kate@pinecone.io, weaviate-eng@weaviate.com, s3-infra@atlasdata.com
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Connector chaos test plan + storage fallback exercise

Kate / Weaviate / Atlas S3 team —

Thanks for moving quickly. Per internal sync, proposed schedule:
- Tue Apr 20 11:00–12:30 PT: Tabletop (all partners) — verify failure matrix and escalation paths
- Thu Apr 22 13:00–16:00 PT: Live run (we'll run staged chaos intervals)

Attachments: failure-modes-matrix.xlsx (matrix with expected behavior and rollback playbooks).

Please confirm the following by EOD Fri Apr 16:
1) Who from each partner will be on-call during the live run (name, Slack handle).
2) Any legal/contract concerns for running intentional faults (we need a short MOA).
3) Access needs: Pinecone & Weaviate — ability to create short-lived diversion indexes; Atlas — temporary S3 bucket role for warmup writes.

I'll create a shared Slack channel and a Drive folder with the harness artifacts and Grafana view. Ben will own telemetry during the run; Olga will own the circuit-breaker rules. Connor will coordinate invites and the run checklist.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: failure-modes-matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)]

-----
From: Kate Lin <kate@pinecone.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: weaviate-eng@weaviate.com, s3-infra@atlasdata.com
Date: Fri, 15 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Connector chaos test plan + storage fallback exercise

Vanessa / Connor —

Confirmed: Pinecone will provide:
- Kate Lin (kate_pinecone on Slack) as primary on-call
- Infrastructure engineer (TBD) to support network partition simulation
- Acceptance of the tabletop & live run dates above.

One legal note: our procurement team asked for a short access annex covering intentional testing in shared environments. If you can share a 1-paragraph MOA we can route internally. Otherwise everything looks green from our side.

See you on Apr 20 for the tabletop.

Warm regards,
Kate
Kate Lin, Partner Engineering | Pinecone
